where_text: the Woodsman's lodge (pinned 'the Woodsman in Haven') on the hill at the south-east edge of town, Z 40
notes: A real choppable oak (0x0CDA) stands 5 tiles south of the lodge door; arm on the open grass just north of it. Lodge: counter with knives and a skinning knife, fireplace, beds. Props: chopping block / log pile. Door is a gap in the south wall (no door static on the map).

where_text: the west pier of the Haven docks, south of the docks street
notes: Arm on the pier planks (Z -2 = plank top). Open static water (0x1799, Z -5) is the tile east (3651,2667) and beyond; the Fisherman spawner is at 3655,2665. No door: the pier head is 3645-3650,2656-2658; sign on the dirt by the pier head at Z -4.

where_text: the grass verge of the dirt road that runs south from the Proving Grounds to the east fields, east edge of town, Z 20
notes: Flat open grass, 3x3 clear, road 3 tiles west, a field to the south. Props: campfire (P1) and wild garlic herb patch (P2). A real fire pit (0x0FAC) at 3704,2596,20 in the farmhouse yard, with fallen logs at 3698-3700,2599, is an alternative camp. Weakest pick: a roadside spot, not a building.

where_text: the Hammer and Steel smithy, the open-air forge stall against the ruined stone wall on the street south of the bank square
notes: Real fixtures from pinned haven.cfg decoration (items placed by [Decorate, not map statics): AnvilSouth 3644,2615 and 3644,2618; SmallForge 3644,2614; LargeForgeEast 3644,2619 (3 tiles). The stall has no roof and no door; it opens east onto the cobbled street. Arm is next to the anvil and 2 from the forge.

building: A Stitch in Time, west room
where_text: A Stitch in Time, the west room (red rug) of the long stone house at the north-east of the loop road
notes: No working loom or wheel indoors: pinned's LoomSouth (3692,2482) and SpinningWheelEast (3691,2485) land OUTSIDE on the grass south of this building (SoS rebuilt it as a rectangle, not pinned's cross). Props P1/P2 for a loom and spinning wheel inside. Arm and props kept west of the walk from the door to the inner doorway 3682,2475 (necromancy room). Existing map signpost at 3675,2480.

where_text: Carpenters of Haven, the L-shaped stone shop on the north side of the loop road, west of the tinker
notes: Arm in the workshop behind the long counter (3640-3644,2501); boards static 3643,2498, writing tables 3640,2497/2504/2506, display cases in the front shop. Props: workbench / sawhorse. Door: south gap 3642-3643,2511 onto the cobbled road. Existing signpost 3646,2512.

where_text: Haven Clockworks and Tinker Shop, on the north side of the loop road east of the carpenters
notes: Real fixtures: tinker's tools static 3669,2505; deco TinkerTools 3668,2504 (z6 on a bench); clock frame on the worktable 3662-3664,2507-2508; broken clock and clock parts on the counter 3658-3659,2504; deco oven 3656,2508. Door: south gap 3667-3668,2511. Existing deco signpost 3666,2512.

where_text: the back kitchen of the Shakin' Bakery building, west side of the courtyard north of the bank (on SoS it reads as a mage's shop: spellbook, wand and scrolls in the front display case, reagents on the kitchen table)
notes: Real reagent table: nox crystal, sulfurous ash, wyrm's heart, dead wood (z3) on the tables 3625-3630,2548-2550; deco stone ovens 3624,2546 and 3624,2548. Door: the shop's east doorway 3631,2539-2540 onto the cobbled courtyard. The Little Shop of Magic (3623-3642,2565-2581) is a roofless ruin of hay, bones and garbage on SoS, so it was not used. Existing signpost 3632,2537.

where_text: the Bullseye Marksmen archery range, open ground at Z 40 east of the Proving Grounds
notes: No bowyer building on SoS: the Bowyer spawner (3745,2585,40) stands on open furrowed ground. Real fixtures: two ArcheryButte decorations 3744,2576 and 3747,2576. Arm 3 tiles south of the buttes. No door. If it must be indoors, use the Carpenters workshop instead.

where_text: the kitchen of the Albatross Bar and Grill, the tavern on the docks street
notes: Real fixtures (pinned deco): StoneOvenSouth 3666,2639 (in the north wall), StoneFireplaceSouth hearth 3669,2640 (chimney above), kettle 3667,2641, pots 3664,2641 / 3669,2642, sack of flour 3666,2643, wine. The kitchen is partly roofless on SoS. Entry: west wall gap 3663,2651-2653 into the bar room, kitchen through 3668-3670,2647. A south door static at 3668,2655 leads to the docks. The Shakin' Bakery ovens (3624,2546/2548) are the alternative.

where_text: the Haven Public Library, the stone hall at the north-west corner of the loop road
notes: Arm beside the reading tables 3610-3611,2474-2477 (desk); rows of bookcases 3616-3622 at 2472 and 2475; Scribe spawner 3615,2476. Door: south gap 3619-3620,2479. Existing metal signpost 3617,2480.

where_text: Mapmakers of Haven, the stone house with the rug on the north side of the docks street
notes: Bookcases on the north wall 3633-3637,2632 (deco), rug room west; the east half is a roofless ruin. Shipwright/Mapmaker spawner 3633,2635. No real door: the way in is the broken north wall at 3636-3638,2631, onto grass; the sign stands on grass (no road within 3 south of it).

where_text: The Haven Thieves' Guild, the L-shaped hall at the east end of the loop road
notes: Real fixtures (pinned deco): PickpocketDipSouth 3695,2507 / 3698,2507 / 3691,2509 / 3689,2509, dart boards 3695,2504 / 3698,2504 / 3688,2512 / 3688,2515, golden chests 3688,2505-2506. Door: south gap 3691-3692,2519. Existing metal signpost 3690,2520.

where_text: the great stone hall of Uzeraan's Mansion, at the town's working ankh (no chapel or paladin hall exists)
notes: Real fixture: AnkhNorth 3606,2582,10 with magical sparkles (pinned deco, the town's working ankh). The hall is roofless flagstone. Door: deco MetalDoor 3612,2587-2588 in the east wall, onto the street. Alternative: the north reading hall of the Shakin' Bakery building (3624-3638,2528-2534), a long table with paladin spellbooks (3630,2530 / 3633,2532). Low-medium confidence.

where_text: Haven Magery School, the south room (stone hall at the north end)
notes: NPC behind the table (3650-3652,2474-2475), facing south toward the door; echo 2 tiles north of the arm, east of the table. None of these is 3651,2477 / 3654,2472 / 3650,2471. Door: south gap 3651-3652,2479.

building: skull-candle hall (Stitch in Time east room)
where_text: the skull-candle hall, east room of the Stitch in Time house (necromancer's shrine)
notes: Raised dais (platform statics, stand Z 2) 3690-3694,2472-2478 with 8 skull candles and skull spikes. Arm west of the dais facing east, echo 2 tiles east of the arm, necromancer on the dais behind the candle line facing west. The room has no outside door: enter by the building's south door 3676-3677,2479 (opens south onto the road), through the west room and the inner doorway 3682,2475 (opens west).

where_text: none: no dojo on the SoS Haven map
notes: No dojo or martial hall exists. P678 put the dojo NPCs in the east cottage 3736-3744,2561-2568 (Z 40, one room with bed and counter, door gap south at 3739,2567). Fallback arm there: 3739,2564,40.
